preconditions.description: The input msg must be a string.

postconditions.description: The output must be a string.

postconditions.expression: len(return_value) == len(msg) // 2 + 1 if len(msg) > 0 else return_value == ''
postconditions.description: The length of the output string is the number of tops, which is half the length of the input string plus one if the input is non-empty, otherwise it is an empty string.

postconditions.expression: all(return_value[i] in msg for i in range(len(return_value)))
postconditions.description: Each character in the output string must be a character from the input string.
